ablation: remove defining conditioning term; preserve allocator and gate
allocation: fixed 0.2 per slot; 0.25 cap; unused slots cash
cash_rule: no positive eligible scores means cash; no midweek reentry
code_sha: PENDING_IMPLEMENTATION; actual frozen source hashes captured before execution
contamination_notes: Earlier research/dev folds reused across A–C; public 2024–2025 examples already observed; no pristine validation claim; live window excluded
cost_hypothesis: weekly entries and persistent eligibility exits; explicit delay sensitivity needed before promotion
data_admissibility: OHLCV_ONLY_PER_REPOSITORY_RULES; no newly admitted external data
failure_mode: weekly execution outlasts reversal or rank signal; state may duplicate generic momentum; rank changes may reflect universe changes
nearest_incumbent: mean_reversion / V10 residual momentum / Frontier-C signed risk transition
portfolio_role: independent satellite only after matched control and incumbent residual tests
rebalance: Monday only; immediate invalid-price/eligibility exits persist until next Monday
selection: positive scores, top five; labels used only for tie breaking
selection_objective: minimum research/dev Sharpe across 0.04/0.08/0.12 ATR slippage; drawdown then turnover
source_notes: OHLCV/execution reference only; economic hypotheses are original research proposals informed by repo frontier, not a claim from official documentation
stop_rule: freeze if central ablation/falsifier matches or beats central base; weak floor 1.0; no post-return parameter expansion; no automatic promotion
thesis: Negative serial dependence predicts reversal of a recent relative loss during a positive market trend.
timing: completed t daily bars; estimated conditioning states through t-1; toolbox owns next-bar execution
transform: VR = var(5-day summed log returns, W) / (5 * var(daily log returns, W)), estimated through t-1. Score = max(1-VR,0) * max(-sum_5(asset minus eligible equal market returns),0); positive 21-day market-return gate. Ablation removes VR; falsifier uses max(VR-1,0).
universe: historical is_liquid == 1 and positive finite close; rank/market cross-section contains current eligible observations only
